items.clause: Annex 1, 3.5: clear height between finished floor and ceiling at least 2.50 m (2.20 m in bathrooms, kitchens, circulation)
items.paraphrase: Catalan habitability decree requires 2.50 m clear height in habitable rooms; lower 2.20 m in service and circulation spaces.
items.note: read 2026-11-14: aplicacions.habitatge.gencat.cat/files/decret141 HABITABILITAT 201260882.pdf; Catalonia only; 2.40 m for some refurbishments

items.clause: Annex 1, 3.9.1: living spaces and bedrooms need openings of at least 1/8 of useful floor area (counted between 0 and 2.5 m height)
items.paraphrase: Catalan decree requires natural-light openings of at least one eighth of the useful floor area for living spaces and bedrooms.
